name: Site Information Architecture
provenance: package name and invariants recovered from prior summary; original sandbox bytes were not persisted

responsibility_rules.TEST_RUNNER: solve the frozen test snapshot; exclude dashboard distractions
responsibility_rules.RESULT: report score and breakdown for one attempt; do not become the learning review workflow
responsibility_rules.REVIEW: consume Stage16/17 mistake and due-review data; do not recalculate test score
responsibility_rules.LESSON_ANALYTICS: explain mastery/history and offer next action; do not duplicate Progress
responsibility_rules.PROGRESS: show longitudinal snapshots; do not become attempt detail

navigation_rules: navigation follows user mental model rather than database structure
every authenticated primary CTA resolves to a guarded canonical destination
stable slugs never depend on translated labels
parameter IDs use stable UUIDs/identifiers rather than display titles
keyboard focus order follows visual task order

stage22: page components, accessibility and responsive implementation
